verdict.rationale: Ask Digits is a first-party natural-language assistant that answers questions about financials and is marketed with a task mode, and the official MCP server lets Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor and other assistants query live ledger data in natural language. However, the MCP route is explicitly read-only, and the claim that Ask Digits can 'complete tasks' rests on a single marketing line with no documented scope. So operating the product, as opposed to querying it, through natural language is only partly shown. missing for 10: documented scope of Ask Digits task execution (which actions it can take, such as booking, bill approval or reports), any write or command capability via natural language through MCP, and independent or hands-on corroboration of natural-language operation.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands

citations.quote: Meet Ask Digits — Ask questions. Complete tasks. Understand your business
Ask Digits anything about your financials—cash flow, expenses, revenue trends, vendor history, budgets, or forecasts—and get clear, accurate answers in seconds
The Digits MCP server is read-only. It can access and analyze your data, but cannot make any changes to your Digits account.
letting AI assistants query live, auto-booked financial data
